r: pnmtosir - convert a PNM image into a Solitaire format

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

pnmtosir reads a PNM image as input and produces a Solitaire Image Recorder format image.

pnmtosir produces an MGI TYPE 17 file for PBM and PGM files. For PPM, it writes a MGI TYPE 11 file.

There are no command line options defined specifically for pnmtosir, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
